verdict.rationale: GrowthBook documents a full REST API and an official MCP server that lets AI tools such as Claude and Cursor make authenticated REST calls, guided by GrowthBook Agent Skills. Its results engine produces decision-relevant statistics such as Chance to Win, with above 95% flagged as a clear winner, so an agent has both an access path and the signals needed to recommend ship or rollback. missing for 10: explicit documentation that the REST API/MCP exposes experiment results and analysis (not just configuration), any documented ship/rollback recommendation workflow, a reachable OpenAPI spec (probe paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of agents summarizing results.
